description: Format a raw manuscript into a professional 6" x 9" trade paperback book interior using Apache OpenOffice Writer. Open the raw text file at '/home/ga/Documents/manuscript_raw.txt' and apply the formatting rules specified in '/home/ga/Documents/print_specs.json'. Specifically: (1) Set page size to 6.00" width x 9.00" height. (2) Set Margins to Mirrored (Inside: 0.8", Outside: 0.5", Top/Bottom: 0.75"). (3) Format body text with a 0.25" first-line indent, justified alignment, and NO spacing between paragraphs. (4) Configure headers to be different on left/right pages: Left (even) pages must display the author name 'J.R. BLACKWOOD' centered; Right (odd) pages must display the book title 'THE ECHOING VOID' centered. (5) Add centered page numbers in the footer. Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/The_Echoing_Void_Formatted.odt'.
